13468: Keima Katsuragi is a 17-year-old high school student attending Maijima High School Academy.
14015: Elsie is a shinigami who was assigned to capture evil spirits that have escaped from hell and is the Deuteragonist of the story.
15449: Shiori is a quiet girl who loves to read books. She is the librarian of the enormous collection of books in the school. Keima immediately catches her attention and anger by saying that books are useless.
15636: A girl in Keima Katsuragi's class at school, Ayumi is a member of the school's track team. She is an exceptional runner and quite likely the best on the team. However, she was bullied by the upperclasswomen in her team.
15637: She is known as the rich girl of Maishima Academy. However, her father passed away over a year ago and has been living in an run down apartment since then. She is the second heroine to appear in the series.
18866: Haqua is a fellow Spirit hunter and friend of Elsie. A 300 year old demon, she is an outstanding honor student and the District Chief of Area 32 in Nagumo City. As a child, she always tried to be the best in everything she does hence her perfect record.
22306: A friend of Ayumi Takahara. Chihiro is a girl who tries to confess to a boy immediately after she thinks that he is handsome and attractive. However, she has confessed to many boys without positive results. Keima describes Chihiro as a "mob character" using visual novel argot.
22307: Nagase is a graduate from Keima Katsuragi's High School and now she's back as a Student Teacher, teaching in Keima's class. She admires the pro wrestler Jumbo Tsuruma and she was revealed to be quite innocent and naive.
22308: Keima's mother resembles a typical shoujo manga-style mother; optimistic, ditsy, and loving. However, when she is angry, Mari removes her glasses and lets her hair down and changes her personality completely. Keima claims that she used to be a part of a biker gang.
22309: Dokurou Skull is hell's branch chief of "counter measures". She assigned Elsie to capture spirits in the human world and sent Keima Katsuragi the contract letter.
22321: Kusunoki is a third year student at Keima's High School. As an initiate of the Ancient Martial Arts Kasuga-Style Life And Death Technique, she hates weakness and tells others of her hate for cute things; however, she secretly loves them.
22322: Kanon is the most popular teen idol around for her beauty and singing talents. She was also in Keima and Elsie's class but had not been in school because of her idol status. However, she returns one day.
22636: A cold girl that loves beautiful things and has a doll called Luna. Is a member of the Astronomy Club.
23160: Minami is a middle school girl that does not quite seem to fit in with the rest of the class. She is often alone and lost in her own thoughts. Minami loves swimming and she is in the school's Swimming Club.
26275: A shy and reticent childhood friend of Keima, who was a former next-door neighbor and classmate until the Katsuragi household relocated seven years ago.
28739: The daughter of the owner of a Chinese restaurant, Keima and Erushia first met her eating ramen in diffefrent ramen stores.
29995: A Goddess that resides in Tenri, she exhibits characteristics of a tsundere and pure maiden; whenever she is in possession of Tenri's body, there is a halo above her head. She and her sisters—so called "Sisters of Jupiter"—sacrificed themselves to seal the Old Hell.
33809: An elderly woman living in the countryside with her granddaughter Airi, whom Keima encounters while visiting his grandparents.
34315: A born sadist, Nikaido is Keima Katsuragi's homeroom and Japanese teacher. She has been ignoring Keima ever since he told her that there are 5012 games that are more fun than her lessons. Nikaido is also a school senior of Jun Nagase.
34316: Maijima High's English teacher and the Head of Arts Clubs.
34317: A second-year Maijima High School Academy student enrolled in Class 2-B. Miyako is a close friend of Ayumi and Chihiro. She has a long hair and freckles on her cheeks. Track-and-field club member. After Chihiro Arc, she became a member of Chihiro's band.
34318: Heroine of "Kureyon - Sora no Art", Atelier Lilith's game for PFP that can't be cleared because of the bugs.
34319: Main heroine of a PFP game. "Yokkyun" who seems to be drawn in a parody style of famed visual novel Kanon. She is the only recurring 'game' character of the series which is described by Keima as 'ideal heroine'.
38910: The chairman of the Library committee.
42206: He's making it to the majors!
73893: Yuri is the former member of Citron and an old friend of Kanon.
153490: Lime is the former leader of Citron and an old friend of Kanon.
